# arin_irr_as_set (Resource)

Manage a simple (XML) ARIN IRR AS set. Owns its full description, remarks, membership, and membership-by-reference. POC links are generated by ARIN from the organization. Advanced RPSL objects are not supported. Import existing sets by name before managing them. Removing this resource from configuration deletes the AS set from ARIN. The lifecycle is tested against a fake server and OT&E; production writes have not been validated.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Use an OT&E provider configuration while evaluating write behavior.
resource "arin_irr_as_set" "peers" {
  name        = "AS-EXAMPLE-PEERS"
  org_handle  = "EXAMPLE-1"
  description = ["Peers of the example network"]
  members     = ["AS64496", "AS64497"]
  remarks     = ["Managed with Terraform"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (List of String) Ordered description lines, at least one. Each entry is one nonempty line without surrounding whitespace.
- `name` (String) Uppercase AS set name (for example AS-EXAMPLE or AS64496:AS-EXAMPLE). Changing it replaces the object.
- `org_handle` (String) Uppercase maintaining organization handle. Changing it replaces the object.

### Optional

- `members` (Set of String) Uppercase AS numbers or AS set names. Defaults to empty; omission clears explicit membership on apply.
- `members_by_ref` (Set of String) Maintainers in MNT-ORG format, or ANY. Defaults to empty; omission clears membership-by-reference on apply.
- `remarks` (List of String) Ordered remarks lines. Defaults to empty; omission clears existing remarks on apply.

### Read-Only

- `creation_date` (String) Creation timestamp reported by ARIN, or null when absent.
- `id` (String) AS set name, also used as the import ID.
- `last_modified_date` (String) Last modification timestamp reported by ARIN, or null when absent.
- `poc_links` (Attributes Set) POC links generated by ARIN from the maintaining organization. These cannot be configured or changed on the AS set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--poc_links))
- `source` (String) IRR source returned by ARIN.

<a id="nestedatt--poc_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `poc_links`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) POC role description returned by ARIN.
- `function` (String) POC role returned by ARIN.
- `handle` (String) POC handle returned by ARIN.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing simple AS set by its name.
terraform import arin_irr_as_set.peers AS-EXAMPLE-PEERS
```
